svg.title: Interactive antisymmetry hexagon
svg.desc: A hexagon illustrating antisymmetry. The center cell with 0 is always highlighted in grey. Hover with a mouse, focus with a keyboard, or tap a cell to highlight that number and the symmetrically opposite number, which is its negative. One horizontal guide line is shown through each highlighted cell.

g.aria-label: Cell -6. The symmetrically opposite cell contains 6. Hover or tap to highlight the antisymmetric pair.
